acks.name: map_fow_ConvertSightToArea
acks.reason: PERMANENT, NOT DEFERRED -- REWRITTEN 2026-08-30. The function returns its pointer in EBP, not EAX, so `dump_call_protos.py` refuses it (RET_OK = EAX/AX/AL/ST0) and mh_calls.gen.h carries MH_UNAVAILABLE__non_standard_return_register. THAT IS CORRECT AND STAYS: the markup is truthful (0 writes to EAX, 10 to EBP over the 29-instruction body) and a plausible-looking thunk returning garbage is exactly what RET_OK exists to prevent. What CHANGED is that NO THUNK IS NEEDED AT ALL. The function is translated as an ORDINARY INTERNAL C++ HELPER (mh::sim::detail::convert_sight_to_area in sim/sim_fog_of_war.cpp -- no shadow arm, no public wrapper, no installer) and is called DIRECTLY in C++ by its only two callers, map_fow_UpdateFoWPlus_impl and llm_strat_fow_remove_sight_apply, both reimplemented in the SAME translation unit. All five rows of the fog/sight family are state=verified, tier T1. So the marshalling layer is never asked to express this signature, and the R1 proto check is flagging a prototype nothing consumes. This ack does not defer work and names no owning item, because there is no work left to own: SIM-EBPRET was closed 2026-08-30 as not needed. REVIVE IT ONLY IF a migration set gains a function that returns in a non-standard register AND is called across the DLL boundary -- the other two refusals in mh_calls.gen.h (llm_lzss_next_flag_bit, LZW_handleCode) are in NO migration set, checked 2026-08-30.
acks.evidence: Body @0x004a6792-0x004a6815 is a 10-way cascade that writes EBP one of ten fixed table addresses (0x5d8852 ... 0x5d8951) and RETs. Measured over the whole 29-instruction body: writes to EAX = 0, writes to EBP = 10. The markup was CORRECTED to EBP on 2026-08-07 (it previously claimed EAX:4, which nothing in the body ever assigns) and that correction is what cleared the 6 `unaff_EBP` tokens from llm_strat_fow_remove_sight_apply and the identical ones from map_fow_UpdateFoWPlus_impl -- i.e. this ack records a REAL contract now written down, not an unread function. Note the blocker is transitional: both of its callers are themselves in the migration set, so once all three are translated they call each other directly in C++ and no thunk is needed at all.

acks.name: llm_strat_bldg_state_charge_gate
acks.reason: Genuine ambient-register input, not a wrong prototype. This is a void(void) fn-ptr dispatch handler (installed by llm_strat_register_state_handlers). It calls llm_strat_bldg_completion_dispatch(player,index,param_3,param_4,clock) while CUR_BUILDING->state is still CHARGE_GATE, landing in dispatch's CHARGE branch which reads NEITHER param_3 (dead in dispatch's entire 387-line body) NOR param_4 (read only on dispatch's construction branch). So the EBX/ECX the handler passes are whatever the dispatcher left in those registers -- provably-unread carry-ins. No prototype change reaches this without splitting the shared dispatcher; dropping dispatch's dead param_3 would remap the real param_4 from ECX to EBX and still leave the ECX artifact.
acks.evidence: completion_dispatch param_3 never referenced outside its signature (full-body text scan, Agent-C triage 2026-08-19). unaff_ECX/extraout_EBX are never assigned in charge_gate's own body (0x00472674). The 4 R1 proto commits + this handler's void() are correct; the token is inherent to the dispatch call shape.

acks.name: llm_strat_bldg_completion_dispatch
acks.reason: SSA noise around a discarded call result, not a prototype defect. In the A_MINE/H_MINE switch case it calls llm_strat_mine_scan_deposit_slot (tagged __mh_watcall_ebx_volatile, return EAX-only) purely for effect -- the CALL at 0x004798c7 is immediately followed by a JMP back to the loop head, nothing captures EAX. Because the callee does not preserve EBX, the decompiler's SSA merge for the loop-carried uVar10 has no real definition on this path and fills extraout_EBX. Provably dead: uVar10 is unconditionally reassigned by the workers block before its one real use at llm_strat_bldg_register_online.
acks.evidence: Raw disasm 0x004798c7-0x004798d4 = CALL then JMP with no EAX capture (Agent-C 2026-08-19). No prototype change touches a discarded volatile-callee result.

acks.name: llm_strat_unit_state_deploy_to_building
acks.reason: Genuine ambient inputs to a callee whose prototype is correct. This void(void) state handler passes EBX/ECX to llm_strat_bldg_construction_complete's param_3/param_4 (which ARE genuinely used by construction_complete's OTHER callers, so its prototype must stay). EBX is player*0x6aa4 but conditionally clobbered by the __mh_watcall_ebx_volatile llm_strat_mother_reelect_primary call with nothing re-establishing it before the construction_complete call; ECX is never written anywhere in this function's body (pure dispatcher carry-in). Neither this handler's void() nor construction_complete's prototype can fix it without restructuring the dispatch mechanism.
acks.evidence: Full raw-disasm sweep of 0x00481a6b shows no write to ECX; reelect call (__mh_watcall_ebx_volatile) clobbers EBX pre-call (Agent-C 2026-08-19). MED confidence.

acks.name: llm_strat_power_generate
acks.reason: A CALLEE THAT PRESERVES EAX, WHICH NO PROTOTYPE CAN SAY. The single artifact is `extraout_EAX` standing in for `_G_LLM_STRAT_CUR_PLAYER * 0x18` -- the byte offset of this player's row -- held live across `CALL utils_math_trunc` @0x0047030e. utils_math_trunc provably does not touch EAX, and its own prototype is already correct (ST0 in, ST0 out, custom storage, plain RET). The defect is that `preserves EAX` is a property of the PROTOTYPE MODEL -- a cspec `<unaffected>` list -- not of a function prototype: every model in x86watcom.cspec (__watcall, __cdecl, __stdcall, __mh_stkprobe, the three __mh_*_volatile) carries EAX as an OUTPUT pentry, hence killed-by-call. So set-function-prototype, custom storage and commit_prototypes.py are all structurally unable to reach this, exactly as the map_fow_ConvertSightToArea ack above is unreachable by a prototype. NOT ACKED AS UNFIXABLE -- the fix is a new cspec prototype model ('plain RET, ST0 in/out, every register preserved') plus pinning utils_math_trunc to it. THAT WORK IS OWNED BY tasks/tooling.md, section 'A cspec model for the register-PRESERVING FPU helpers (opened 2026-08-23)', which is deliberately batched with the two cspec items already parked there ('__stdcall register-preservation sweep' and '__mh_stkprobe is misnamed now'): a cspec edit is read only at program-open, so it is Ghidra-restart-scoped, and this project's recorded posture is 'not worth a restart on its own; fold it into the next session that already needs one'. A migration-loop session cannot take a restart without losing ReVA, and changing the decompilation of the whole binary is not a call an unattended session should make alone. MEANWHILE THE TRANSLATOR IS NOT MISLED: the mechanism is written into this function's plate AND into utils_math_trunc's (EN v-see-2026-08-23 commit), both naming the instruction addresses, so a reader who opens either one gets the right reading.
acks.evidence: EAX is established by `MOVZX EAX,word ptr [0x00e58144]` @0x004702d3 + `IMUL EAX,EAX,0x18` @0x004702da and is never written again in the body -- the intervening work runs through EDX (@0x004702dd, @0x004702f3) and the x87 stack. The same EAX is the base of the matching READ `FILD dword ptr [EAX + 0xbf4fc0]` @0x004702fc and of the WRITE `FISTP dword ptr [EAX + 0xbf4fc0]` @0x00470313, i.e. a read-modify-write of _G_LLM_STRAT_POWER_STATS[player].generated. PRESERVATION PROVED BY EXHAUSTION, not inferred: utils_math_trunc's entire body is 11 instructions, 0x004d0596-0x004d05b2 -- PUSH EAX / FSTCW [ESP] / WAIT / PUSH dword[ESP] / MOV byte[ESP+1],0x1f / FLDCW [ESP] / FRNDINT / FLDCW [ESP+4] / WAIT / LEA ESP,[ESP+8] / RET. Writes to EAX = 0 (the PUSH reads it, and the LEA releases the 8 bytes of scratch); no other GPR appears at all; getStackPurgeSize() = 0, agreeing with the plain RET. SCOPE MEASURED rather than asserted: of utils_math_trunc's 374 call sites (Ghidra reference sweep), ~18 hold a value in EAX across the call, in 4 functions -- this one, cfg_final_building_Construct (10, e.g. 0x459302), llm_strat_bldg_get_progress_percent (6, e.g. 0x44a14d), llm_tact_unit_apply_move_offset (0x42c538). Only this one is in the sim migration set, and it is the ONLY live EAX artifact among all 530 exported sim listings (grep over tmp/decomp_sim/*.c). That small blast radius is why the cspec change is batched rather than taken now. HIGH confidence.

acks.name: llm_strat_bldg_anim_state_helipad
acks.reason:
SSA noise around a call that GENUINELY clobbers EBX, and the value is provably unread. Same mechanism as the llm_strat_bldg_completion_dispatch ack above, not the ambient-carry-in shape of the three llm_strat_bldg_state_* ones. The two `extraout_EBX` tokens sit in ONE place: the door-release block, where `llm_strat_target_release_ref(player, unit, 3)` is called for effect and returns having destroyed EBX -- it is tagged __mh_watcall_ebx_volatile, which is CORRECT (its prologue saves ECX/ESI/EDI and not EBX), so retyping it away would trade an honest artifact for a silently stale value. The decompiler therefore re-defines the EBX-backed variable after the call, and names the new definition extraout_EBX.

WHY NO PROTOTYPE FIXES IT, checked in both directions rather than assumed. (1) On this function: its prototype was corrected in the same session -- it is now `void __watcall (undefined4 unused_eax, undefined4 unused_edx, uint unused_ebx, uint unused_ecx)`, matching its six anim-handler siblings, and the token survived that (it is not about the entry contract; nothing in this body reads any register before writing it). (2) On the callee side: the only READER of the EBX variable is the `llm_strat_bldg_online_helipad_h_or_misc` call, which declares param_3 in EBX -- and that callee never reads EBX at all, so the value cannot affect anything. Removing param_3/param_4 there would clear the token, but that is a FOURTEEN-function family decision, not a fix to this function: every one of llm_strat_bldg_register_online and its thirteen llm_strat_bldg_online_* handlers carries the identical `(player AX/EAX, building_index EDX, param_3 EBX, param_4 ECX, double anim_dur Stack[0x4])` shape in which EBX and ECX are never read and no call site sets them; some are on CUSTOM storage (safe to trim) and some on DYNAMIC (trimming would relocate the stack double), and the project already has the opposite precedent recorded -- llm_strat_unit_predict_coords_after_delay and llm_strat_bldg_start_special_anim KEEP those slots and name them `unused_ebx`/`unused_ecx`, which is necessary there because real parameters follow them. Taking that decision would change how future sessions model table-dispatched and slot-skipping Watcom signatures, so it is not one an unattended session should take; it is written up in the session report and in SIM1-BLDGCB's progress.

SO THE ARTIFACT IS HARMLESS AND THE TRANSLATOR IS NOT MISLED: the value is a dead store on a branch that does not reach its only consumer, and its only consumer ignores it.
acks.evidence:
The clobbering call: `MOV EBX,0x3` @0x00477762 (the literal third argument) then `CALL 0x004dac44` @0x00477771 = llm_strat_target_release_ref, whose prologue pushes ECX/ESI/EDI only and whose epilogue pops the same three -- EBX is not preserved, which is what __mh_watcall_ebx_volatile records. In the decompile that is the single line `unused_ebx = extraout_EBX;` immediately after the release call, inside `if (units[..].target2_ref != 0)`.

DEADNESS, derived twice. (a) IN THIS FUNCTION: an instruction sweep over the whole body (0x004773f4-0x00477880) finds exactly two reads of EBX -- `SHL EBX,0x2` @0x00477828 and `ADD EDX,EBX` @0x0047782b -- and both consume the value written three bytes earlier by `MOV EBX,dword ptr [EBP + -0x1c]` @0x00477825, in the anim-chain-advance branch. Neither reads the incoming or the post-call value. Read-before-written over EAX/EBX/ECX/EDX across the entire body: NONE. (b) IN THE CONSUMER: llm_strat_bldg_online_helipad_h_or_misc (0x00475233-0x004753e4) has read-before-written = {EAX, EDX} only. Its three EBX reads (`ADD EAX,EBX` @0x00475281, `ADD EAX,EBX` @0x004752c0, `ADD EDX,EBX` @0x0047531c) each consume a value written by the IMUL immediately above them (@0x00475274, @0x004752b3, @0x00475315), and ECX is neither read nor written anywhere in it. Its two call sites -- llm_strat_bldg_register_online @0x00474936 and this function @0x0047780a -- set neither register (this one loads only EDX from _G_LLM_STRAT_CUR_INDEX @0x004777fc and EAX from _G_LLM_STRAT_CUR_PLAYER @0x00477803, plus the two stack pushes of the double). REACHABILITY: this function's only reference of any kind is the PARAM ref at 0x0045f9d5 from llm_strat_register_bldg_type_callbacks, i.e. it is reached solely through llm_strat_bldg_tick_animation_state's `CALL dword ptr [EAX + 0xae49c0]` @0x00476437, which sets up no arguments at all (EAX there is building_id*4 and EDX is player*0x6aa4 -- neither is a player or an index, which is why the old `player`/`index` parameter NAMES were replaced with `unused_eax`/`unused_edx`). HIGH confidence.
